rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: High melanin saturation across the rhinarium surface, with dark pixels estimated at >90% coverage; a localized area of lighter/pinkish pixels is visible on the superior central apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bicolored mane coloration, showing a transition from light tawny/blonde fur on the crown and forehead to dark brown/black hair on the ventral portion of the mane.
